name: Minerador de conteúdo
description: Sweeps the past day's AI news across the open web, X and Instagram, ranks what is actually getting traction, and hands a copywriter a briefing to turn into posts. Built for teams shipping daily social content in Portuguese; the writing itself stays with the human.
